title: QUIZ - 29
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate a total processed quantity from a rate and a duration
questions.question: A server processes 357 requests per second. How many requests does it process in 12 seconds?
questions.explanation: Multiply the rate by the time: 357 requests/second \(\times 12\) seconds = 4284 requests.
questions.hint: Multiply the rate (per second) by the number of seconds to get the total count.

questions.learningObjective: Estimate execution time from a total operation count and a processing rate
questions.question: A program performs 7,000,000 operations at a rate of 2,000,000 operations per second. How many seconds does it take to finish (rounded to two decimal places)?
questions.explanation: Time = total operations \(\div\) rate \(= 7,000,000 \div 2,000,000 = 3.5\) seconds.
questions.hint: Divide the total number of operations by the processing rate to find the total time.

questions.concept: Computing Time from Rate and Quantity
questions.learningObjective: Divide a total quantity by a rate to determine elapsed time
questions.question: A file of 608 MB is downloaded at 10 MB/s. How many seconds does the download take (rounded to two decimal places)?
questions.explanation: Time = size \(\div\) rate = 608 MB \(\div 10\) MB/s = 60.8 seconds.
questions.hint: Divide the total data size by the transfer rate to find the time required.
